points.description: States that the stimulus is the falling cup, detected by seeing it (and/or hearing it) fall. Accept 'the cup falling', 'the cup dropping', or 'seeing/hearing the cup fall'. Do not accept the hand moving, the hit/miss result, or the reaction/response alone.

rubric.notes: Full mark for identifying the falling cup (seen or heard) as the stimulus. No marks for naming the response (moving the hand), the outcome (hit/miss), or the reaction time.
